items.title: Michael Moore interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997
items.q: Because you know Dan Barrett said you know, “I love your solo” on something

ctx.x: I wonder if I got a cassette of that or something. See, maybe it’s not on a cassette. But I didn’t think it was on the one I had. Because you know Dan Barrett said you know, “I love your solo” on something, and I said, “Really?”
Well it’s there. You think you’ll have to go out and buy it?
